extension.description: Tomcat Agent Box, an AI coding agent in your VS Code sidebar.
config.path: Path to the tomcat executable used to launch `tomcat serve --stdio`.
config.extraArgs: Additional CLI arguments passed to `tomcat serve --stdio`.
config.defaultCwd: Default working directory used when creating a new Tomcat session. Empty means the first workspace folder.
config.controlsInset: Distance in pixels from sidebar edges to the session bar and input box. Reload the window to apply.
config.contentInset: Distance in pixels from sidebar edges to replies, tool cards, todos and attachments. Set greater than Controls Inset to align input text with replies. Reload the window to apply.
config.maxFiles: Maximum workspace files indexed for `@` context search. Larger workspaces stop at this cap to keep the sidebar responsive.
config.buildModel: Model used when building a plan from the plan preview or a plan card. Empty means the session's current model is used.
config.toolbarHybrid: Hybrid (default): the editor title bar omits Build/model; a slim in-body action strip keeps the yellow Build button and the model dropdown.
config.toolbarNative: Full native: Build and model live on the editor title bar (icons + QuickPick); the body has no action strip.
config.toolbarStyle: Temporary A/B switch for where the plan preview shows its Build / model controls. Preview/Markdown always lives in the editor title bar overflow menu.
